cards.meaning: by means of; as of (a time)
cards.example: 本日をもちまして、受付を終了いたします。
cards.exampleEn: As of today, we are closing applications.
cards.note: N + をもって. (1) means/basis: 書面をもって; (2) time limit/end: 本日をもって. Formal notices.

cards.example: 契約に際して、身分証明書をご提示ください。
cards.exampleEn: Please present ID when signing the contract.
cards.note: N / V-dict + に際して. Special one-time events; formal.

cards.example: 新製品の発売に先立ち、記者発表会を行います。
cards.exampleEn: Ahead of the new product launch, we'll hold a press conference.
cards.note: N / V-dict + に先立ち（に先立って）. Something done in preparation before an event.

cards.example: 交渉の結果いかんでは、計画を見直す可能性もある。
cards.exampleEn: Depending on the outcome of negotiations, we may revise the plan.
cards.note: N(の) + いかんでは. The outcome may change (often to something unusual).

cards.example: 理由のいかんにかかわらず、返金はいたしかねます。
cards.exampleEn: Regardless of the reason, we cannot issue refunds.
cards.note: N(の) + いかんにかかわらず／いかんによらず. Formal notices and terms.

cards.example: 周囲の心配をよそに、新店舗は初月から黒字となった。
cards.exampleEn: Despite everyone's worries, the new store was profitable from its first month.
cards.note: N + をよそに. Disregarding others' concerns/expectations; slightly critical tone.

cards.example: 大型連休とあって、空港は朝から混雑している。
cards.exampleEn: Since it's a long holiday, the airport has been crowded since morning.
cards.note: Plain form (N/なA without だ) + とあって. Notable circumstance → natural result. News style.

cards.example: 海外市場を開拓すべく、現地法人を設立した。
cards.exampleEn: We set up a local subsidiary in order to develop overseas markets.
cards.note: V-dict + べく (する→すべく). Formal purpose; not used with requests/commands.

cards.example: 資材不足により、工場は操業停止を余儀なくされた。
cards.exampleEn: Due to material shortages, the factory was forced to suspend operations.
cards.note: N + を余儀なくされる. Unavoidable circumstances force an unwanted action. News style.

cards.meaning: when it comes to (a higher level)
cards.example: 管理職ともなると、部下の育成も重要な仕事になる。
cards.exampleEn: Once you become a manager, developing staff becomes an important part of the job.
cards.note: N / V-dict + ともなると（ともなれば）. At this advanced stage/position, naturally X.

cards.example: 経験の有無にかかわらず、応募を歓迎します。
cards.exampleEn: We welcome applications regardless of experience.
cards.note: N + にかかわらず; also V-dict V-ない (参加するしないにかかわらず). Covers contrasting cases.

cards.meaning: in line with, in accordance with (facts)
cards.example: 実態に即した支援策を検討する必要がある。
cards.exampleEn: We need to consider support measures that match actual conditions.
cards.note: N + に即して（に即した N）. Conforming to actual conditions or rules.

cards.example: 前回の反省を踏まえて、スケジュールに余裕を持たせた。
cards.exampleEn: Learning from last time, we built extra slack into the schedule.
cards.note: N + を踏まえて（を踏まえた N）. Basing a decision on prior results/opinions.

cards.example: 理由が何であれ、無断欠勤は認められない。
cards.exampleEn: Whatever the reason, absence without notice is not allowed.
cards.note: N + であれ; N であれ N であれ (whether A or B). Same applies in all cases.

cards.example: 老舗ならではのきめ細かなサービスが評価された。
cards.exampleEn: The attentive service unique to a long-established firm was praised.
cards.note: N + ならでは（の N）. Praises distinctive strengths.

cards.example: 好調な国内事業にひきかえ、海外事業は苦戦している。
cards.exampleEn: In contrast to strong domestic business, overseas operations are struggling.
cards.note: N / plain(なの) + にひきかえ. Contrast with evaluative feeling (often negative for one side).

cards.example: 景気が回復したとはいえ、中小企業の経営は依然厳しい。
cards.exampleEn: Although the economy has recovered, small businesses still face hardship.
cards.note: Plain form / N + とはいえ. Admits fact, then states a reality that differs from expectation.

cards.example: 言うまでもなく、納期厳守が最優先です。
cards.exampleEn: Needless to say, meeting the deadline is the top priority.
cards.note: V-dict + までもない. Obvious; doing it would be superfluous.

cards.example: この案件を任せられるのは、彼をおいてほかにいない。
cards.exampleEn: There is no one but him we can entrust this project to.
cards.note: N + をおいて（ほかに）〜ない. Praises the sole suitable candidate.

cards.example: 今回の不祥事は、業界全体に影響を与えずにはおかないだろう。
cards.exampleEn: This scandal will inevitably affect the whole industry.
cards.note: V-ない stem + ずにはおかない (する→せずには). Something inevitably brings about an effect.

cards.example: 売上は全店で減少し、新宿店に至っては前年の半分だった。
cards.exampleEn: Sales fell at every store; Shinjuku was down to half of last year.
cards.note: N + に至っては. Introduces the most extreme example, usually negative.

cards.example: 設計から梱包に至るまで、すべて自社で行っています。
cards.exampleEn: We handle everything in-house, from design down to packaging.
cards.note: N + に至るまで. Emphasizes range extending to the smallest/farthest item.

cards.example: 厳しい市場環境をものともせず、同社は増益を達成した。
cards.exampleEn: Undaunted by the harsh market, the company achieved higher profits.
cards.note: N + をものともせず. Overcoming difficulty with courage; about others, praise.

cards.example: 東京店を皮切りに、全国十都市に出店する予定だ。
cards.exampleEn: Starting with Tokyo, we plan to open in ten cities nationwide.
cards.note: N + を皮切りに（として）. First in a series of expanding events.

cards.example: この不況下にあって、同社の業績は際立っている。
cards.exampleEn: Amid this recession, the company's results stand out.
cards.note: N + にあって. In a special circumstance; formal written style.

cards.example: 今回の不正には、怒りを禁じ得ない。
cards.exampleEn: I can't help feeling anger at this fraud.
cards.note: N (emotion) + を禁じ得ない. Strong emotion, formal; e.g. 驚き・同情・怒り.

cards.example: 今月を限りに、この製品の販売を終了します。
cards.exampleEn: We will discontinue this product at the end of this month.
cards.note: N (time) + を限りに. Marks the final point after which something ends.

cards.example: 御社の技術力をもってすれば、実現は難しくないはずです。
cards.exampleEn: With your technical capabilities, it shouldn't be hard to achieve.
cards.note: N + をもってすれば. With such strength, even hard things are possible.

cards.example: この予算は一円たりとも無駄にできない。
cards.exampleEn: We cannot waste even a single yen of this budget.
cards.note: 一 + counter + たりとも〜ない. Strong negation of the smallest amount.

cards.example: 小規模ながらも、同社は高い技術力を誇る。
cards.exampleEn: Although small, the company boasts high technical capability.
cards.note: V-stem / A / N + ながらも. Concession: despite X, Y.

cards.example: 好調な予測とは裏腹に、実際の売上は伸び悩んだ。
cards.exampleEn: Contrary to the optimistic forecast, actual sales stagnated.
cards.note: N + とは裏腹に. Result opposite to appearance/expectation/words.

cards.example: 彼の報告は信頼に足る内容だった。
cards.exampleEn: His report was trustworthy.
cards.note: V-dict / N + に足る. Has enough value; often 信頼に足る.

cards.example: 多大なるご支援を賜り、感謝に堪えません。
cards.exampleEn: We are deeply grateful for your tremendous support.
cards.note: (1) V-dict + に堪えない: too bad to bear (見るに堪えない); (2) N + に堪えない: deeply feel (感謝に堪えない).

cards.example: 皆様のご活躍を心より願ってやみません。
cards.exampleEn: I sincerely hope for your continued success.
cards.note: V-て + やまない. Strong, lasting feelings (願う・期待する・祈る). Speeches and letters.

cards.example: これだけの成果を上げたのだから、評価されてしかるべきだ。
cards.exampleEn: With such results, they deserve recognition.
cards.note: V-て + しかるべきだ. It would be appropriate/natural to.

cards.example: 利益はおろか、人件費さえ賄えない状況だ。
cards.exampleEn: We can't even cover labor costs, let alone make a profit.
cards.note: N + はおろか, N も〜. Mostly negative contexts.

cards.example: 価格もさることながら、品質の高さが選ばれる理由だ。
cards.exampleEn: Price matters, but it's the high quality that makes us the choice.
cards.note: N + もさることながら. Acknowledges A, emphasizes B more.

cards.example: 国内のみならず、アジア各国でも販売を開始した。
cards.exampleEn: We began sales not only domestically but across Asia.
cards.note: Plain form / N + のみならず. Formal version of だけでなく.

cards.meaning: it would be one thing if ... but
cards.example: 新人ならいざ知らず、ベテランがこのミスをするとは。
cards.exampleEn: It'd be one thing for a newcomer, but a veteran making this mistake?
cards.note: N / plain + ならいざ知らず. Exception for A, but B is different/unacceptable.

cards.example: 今年は例年にもまして受注が好調だ。
cards.exampleEn: Orders are even stronger this year than usual.
cards.note: N / 疑問詞 + にもまして. Degree exceeds the comparison.

cards.example: 創業五十周年を機に、ロゴを一新した。
cards.exampleEn: We refreshed our logo on the occasion of our 50th anniversary.
cards.note: N + を機に（して）. An event triggers a new action.

cards.example: 消費者からの苦情を受けて、表示を改善した。
cards.exampleEn: In response to consumer complaints, we improved the labeling.
cards.note: N + を受けて. Action taken in reaction to an event/report.

cards.example: 社内規定に照らして、処分を決定する。
cards.exampleEn: We will decide on the penalty in light of company rules.
cards.note: N + に照らして（照らし合わせて）. Judging against rules/standards.

cards.example: 昨今の情勢に鑑み、出張を当面自粛いたします。
cards.exampleEn: In view of current circumstances, we will refrain from business trips for now.
cards.note: N + に鑑み（鑑みて）. Very formal; official decisions and notices.

cards.example: 法令に則って、適切に処理いたします。
cards.exampleEn: We will handle it appropriately in accordance with the law.
cards.note: N + に則って（に則り）. Follows established rules, laws, procedures.

cards.example: 長期契約を前提に、単価を下げることが可能です。
cards.exampleEn: We can lower the unit price on the premise of a long-term contract.
cards.note: N + を前提に（として）. A condition assumed beforehand.

cards.example: ご挨拶かたがた、新任の担当者をご紹介に伺います。
cards.exampleEn: We'll visit to pay our respects and introduce the new person in charge.
cards.note: N (action noun) + かたがた. Doing two purposes at once; formal, letters (お礼かたがた).

cards.example: 取引先回りがてら、新店舗の様子を見てきます。
cards.exampleEn: While visiting clients, I'll check on the new store.
cards.note: N / V-stem + がてら. Using one action as an opportunity for another; casual-ish.

cards.example: 彼は本業のかたわら、地域の起業支援も行っている。
cards.exampleEn: Besides his main job, he also supports local startups.
cards.note: N の / V-dict + かたわら. Long-term parallel activity besides main work.

cards.example: 新商品は発売されるや否や、売り切れた。
cards.exampleEn: The new product sold out the moment it was released.
cards.note: V-dict + や否や（や）. The next event happens instantly; written style.

cards.example: 社長が会議室に入るが早いか、報告が始まった。
cards.exampleEn: No sooner had the president entered than the reports began.
cards.note: V-dict / V-た + が早いか. Immediately after; not for own volition.

cards.example: 在庫を補充するそばから注文が入り、追いつかない。
cards.exampleEn: Orders come in as soon as we restock, and we can't keep up.
cards.note: V-dict / V-た + そばから. Repeated frustration: as soon as X, Y undoes it.

cards.example: 今期は増収増益、新規受注と、いいことずくめだ。
cards.exampleEn: This term has been all good news: higher sales, profits, and new orders.
cards.note: N + ずくめ. Filled entirely with (often good things: いいことずくめ).

cards.example: 当社は前例にとらわれるきらいがある。
cards.exampleEn: Our company tends to be bound by precedent.
cards.note: V-dict / N の + きらいがある. Undesirable tendency; critical.

cards.example: いくら良い商品でも、知られなければそれまでだ。
cards.exampleEn: No matter how good a product is, if no one knows about it, that's the end.
cards.note: V-ば + それまでだ. All effort becomes meaningless if that happens.

cards.example: 断られたら、別の取引先を探すまでだ。
cards.exampleEn: If they turn us down, we'll simply look for another supplier.
cards.note: V-dict + までだ: resolve (I'll just do X); V-た + までだ: I merely did X.

cards.example: 顧客情報の流出は、企業としてあるまじき失態だ。
cards.exampleEn: Leaking customer data is a blunder unacceptable for a company.
cards.note: V-dict + まじき N（する→すまじき）. Conduct unacceptable for a role.

cards.example: 大手銀行ともあろうものが、このような不正をするとは。
cards.exampleEn: That a major bank, of all things, would commit such fraud.
cards.note: N + ともあろう + N. Criticizes someone whose position should prevent the act.

cards.example: 新入社員ではあるまいし、報告くらい自分でできるだろう。
cards.exampleEn: You're not a new hire—surely you can report on your own.
cards.note: N + ではあるまいし（じゃあるまいし）. Rebuke/advice, conversational.

cards.example: これだけの損失を出しては、責任を問われずにはすまない。
cards.exampleEn: With losses this large, someone will inevitably be held responsible.
cards.note: V-ない stem + ずにはすまない（する→せずには）. Obliged by social norms/circumstance.

cards.example: 条件次第では、値引きに応じないものでもない。
cards.exampleEn: Depending on the terms, we might be willing to offer a discount.
cards.note: V-ない + ものでもない. Reluctant possibility.

cards.example: 出張にかこつけて観光ばかりするのは困る。
cards.exampleEn: It's a problem to use business trips as an excuse for sightseeing.
cards.note: N + にかこつけて. Uses an excuse to do something else.

cards.example: お客様のご要望とあれば、休日でも対応いたします。
cards.exampleEn: If it's a customer's request, we'll respond even on holidays.
cards.note: N / plain + とあれば. If that's the special case, will do anything.

cards.example: 早めに相談してくれれば対応できたものを。
cards.exampleEn: If only you'd consulted us earlier, we could have dealt with it.
cards.note: Plain form + ものを. Regret that a better outcome was possible.

cards.example: 部長にしたところで、この決定には不満だろう。
cards.exampleEn: Even the manager is probably unhappy with this decision.
cards.note: N + にしたところで（にしたって）. Even from that standpoint, same conclusion.

cards.example: お休みのところを申し訳ありませんが、至急ご確認ください。
cards.exampleEn: Sorry to disturb your day off, but please check urgently.
cards.note: Plain form / N の + ところを. Polite set phrases: お忙しいところを, お休みのところを.

cards.example: 円安と相まって、輸出企業の業績が好調だ。
cards.exampleEn: Combined with the weak yen, exporters are performing well.
cards.note: N + と相まって. Two factors together intensify an effect.

cards.example: 三回の面接を経て、採用が決まった。
cards.exampleEn: After three interviews, the hiring was decided.
cards.note: N + を経て. Passing through stages/procedures.

cards.example: 目標を達成せんがため、全社一丸となって取り組んだ。
cards.exampleEn: In order to achieve the goal, the whole company worked as one.
cards.note: V-ない stem + んがため（に）(する→せんがため). Literary, strong purpose.

cards.example: この問題は一企業にとどまらず、業界全体の課題だ。
cards.exampleEn: This issue isn't limited to one company; it affects the entire industry.
cards.note: N / V-dict + にとどまらず. Range extends beyond.

cards.example: このような賞をいただき、光栄の至りです。
cards.exampleEn: Receiving such an award is the greatest honor.
cards.note: N + の至り. Set phrases: 光栄の至り, 恐縮の至り, 若気の至り.

cards.example: 大切な顧客を失ったのは、痛恨の極みだ。
cards.exampleEn: Losing an important client is extremely regrettable.
cards.note: N + の極み. Extreme degree (痛恨の極み, 贅沢の極み).

cards.example: 社長は体調不良を押して、株主総会に出席した。
cards.exampleEn: Despite feeling unwell, the president attended the shareholders' meeting.
cards.note: N + を押して. Doing something despite difficulty (病・反対).

cards.example: 新年度を迎えるにあたり、組織を再編いたしました。
cards.exampleEn: As we begin the new fiscal year, we have reorganized.
cards.note: N / V-dict + にあたり（にあたって）. Formal; starting something important. Similar to に際して but forward-looking.

cards.example: 研修を兼ねて、新人を展示会に同行させた。
cards.exampleEn: We took the new hire to the trade show, which also served as training.
cards.note: N + を兼ねて. One action with two purposes.

cards.example: 関係者とおぼしき人物から情報が漏れたようだ。
cards.exampleEn: Information seems to have leaked from someone apparently involved.
cards.note: N + とおぼしき N. Written/news style; "seems to be."

cards.example: 最新の技術をもってしても、原因の特定は困難だった。
cards.exampleEn: Even with the latest technology, identifying the cause was difficult.
cards.note: N + をもってしても〜ない. Even this strong means isn't enough.

cards.example: 大手の資金力には、到底太刀打ちすべくもない。
cards.exampleEn: There's no way we can compete with the financial power of big firms.
cards.note: V-dict + べくもない. Impossible from the start; literary.

cards.example: 今期の営業利益は過去最高になるとみられる。
cards.exampleEn: Operating profit this term is expected to hit a record high.
cards.note: Plain form + とみられる. News reporting of estimates.

cards.example: 年内をめどに、新システムを導入する予定です。
cards.exampleEn: We plan to introduce the new system by around the end of the year.
cards.note: N (time/amount) + をめどに. Rough target in plans.
